title: Understand a Hotel Notice
wrap_friend: 你剛剛完成了一段 A2 住宿服務情境，說明需求、聽懂回覆，並確認下一步。
learner_goal: Understand a short hotel notice and confirm time, place, and rule details.
register_notes: Broad everyday English hotel-service register; polite, short A2 responses; no complaint escalation.
support_text: Understand a short hotel notice and confirm the time, place, and rule.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Please look at the notice. Breakfast is from seven to nine in the morning.
turns.speak: Please look at the notice. Breakfast is from seven to nine in the morning.
turns.translation: 請看公告。早餐是早上七點到九點。

friend.hint: Find the time in the notice.

choices.surface: Breakfast is from seven to nine in the morning, right?
choices.translation: 早餐是早上七點到九點，對嗎？
choices.speak: Breakfast is from seven to nine in the morning, right?

choices.surface: Breakfast is from seven to nine at night, right?
choices.translation: 早餐是晚上七點到九點，對嗎？
choices.speak: Breakfast is from seven to nine at night, right?
choices.feedback: The notice says in the morning.

choices.surface: Checkout is at nine in the morning, right?
choices.speak: Checkout is at nine in the morning, right?
choices.feedback: This notice is about breakfast, not checkout.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: It is in the restaurant on the second floor.
turns.speak: It is in the restaurant on the second floor.

inline_explain.title: A2 pattern
inline_explain.explain: A useful pattern for this accommodation situation.

choices.surface: I go to the second-floor restaurant, right?
choices.translation: 去二樓餐廳就可以，對嗎？
choices.speak: I go to the second-floor restaurant, right?

choices.surface: I go to a third-floor room, right?
choices.translation: 去三樓房間就可以，對嗎？
choices.speak: I go to a third-floor room, right?
choices.feedback: The place is the restaurant on the second floor.

choices.translation: 給您看護照就可以，對嗎？
choices.feedback: A passport is not needed for this notice.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: At the entrance, please just say your room number.
turns.speak: At the entrance, please just say your room number.
turns.translation: 入口只要告知房號即可。

choices.surface: I just say my room number at the entrance, right?
choices.translation: 入口只要說房號就可以，對嗎？
choices.speak: I just say my room number at the entrance, right?

choices.surface: I talk to the police at the entrance, right?
choices.speak: I talk to the police at the entrance, right?
choices.feedback: This is a breakfast notice, not a police process.

choices.surface: I get a refund at the entrance, right?
choices.speak: I get a refund at the entrance, right?
choices.feedback: Refunds do not fit this notice task.

choices.surface: Okay. I will go to the second-floor restaurant tomorrow morning.
choices.translation: 好，我明天早上去二樓餐廳。
choices.speak: Okay. I will go to the second-floor restaurant tomorrow morning.

choices.surface: Okay. I will pick up laundry tonight.
choices.speak: Okay. I will pick up laundry tonight.

choices.surface: Okay. I will write an accident report.
choices.speak: Okay. I will write an accident report.
choices.feedback: Accident reports are outside this task.

feedback: Distractors test wrong time, place, service domain, or out-of-scope escalation while preserving A2 boundaries.
tts_segments: Please look at the notice. Breakfast is from seven to nine in the morning.
It is in the restaurant on the second floor.
At the entrance, please just say your room number.
runtime_notes: EN A2 accommodation candidate. Full-walk runtime gate required before final closeout.

notes.authoring_policy: Fresh-authored from the neutral A2 accommodation brief. KO surfaces were not translated.
notes.a2_boundary: Low-risk accommodation/service task; avoids compensation, emergency, legal, medical, police, immigration, banking, insurance, or identity-sensitive handling.
